WV6-P02.4.note: Cloths go over the seedlings on cold nights to shield them from the frost that kills the flowers, so 'cover' means protect; 'carpet' (spread over a surface) misses that the point is shelter.

WV6-P02.5.note: The author doubts the plan will work but presents it as a reasonable answer to something no vote can fix, which is worry rather than criticism; 'critical' is the nearest lure.
